groups.title: Administrative boundaries
groups.what: Country, province and district polygons with P-codes and trilingual names.
groups.source: OCHA/HDX Common Operational Dataset, uzb_admbnda 2018b

groups.title: Basin watersheds, levels 1-12
groups.what: Pfafstetter sub-basins at every level, with downstream routing and the level-12 frame everything else joins onto.
groups.source: HydroSHEDS HydroBASINS v1c, and the BasinATLAS extraction in standard format

groups.title: River reaches
groups.what: Routed river network with downstream links, Strahler order, discharge and catchment area per reach.
groups.source: HydroSHEDS HydroRIVERS v1.0 Asia, selected by the full Amu and Syr basin frame
groups.note: Native HYRIV_ID and NEXT_DOWN are preserved without administrative clipping.

groups.title: Lakes and reservoirs
groups.what: Water bodies with area, volume, depth and the basin each sits in, at two scopes: clipped to Uzbekistan, and over the whole Amu and Syr systems.
groups.source: HydroSHEDS HydroLAKES v1.0
groups.note: The national layer holds 647 bodies and 10 reservoirs; the whole-basin layer holds 1,393 and 23, and it is the one that contains Toktogul, Nurek and Kayrakkum.

groups.title: Dams and reservoir regulation
groups.what: Barriers with name, year of completion, height, nominal capacity and operating purpose, linked to the basin, the reach and the water body each one acts on.
groups.source: Global Dam Watch v1.0, selected by the full Amu and Syr basin frame
groups.note: GDW carries GRAND_ID, HYRIV_ID, HYLAK_ID and HYBAS_L12 natively, so every link is read from the source rather than computed. CC BY 4.0.

groups.title: Wastewater treatment plants
groups.what: Treatment plants with population served, treated discharge, level of treatment and the dilution factor of the reach receiving the outfall.
groups.source: HydroWASTE v1.0, selected by the published Amu and Syr reach network
groups.note: The project's first water-quality layer. Every Central Asian record is modelled from urban population rather than reported by a register, and the per-plant quality codes say so. CC BY 4.0.

groups.title: River reach classification and connectivity
groups.what: What each reach is, from GloRiC's hydrologic, physio-climatic and geomorphic types, and how far it is still connected, from the Free-Flowing Rivers Connectivity Status Index and its six pressure indicators.
groups.source: GloRiC v1.0 and Free-Flowing Rivers v1.0, over the published Amu and Syr reaches
groups.note: Both sources key on their own reach identifier rather than HYRIV_ID; the build verifies the correspondence against the published network and refuses to write a partial table.

groups.title: Pskem station observations
groups.what: Monthly meteorology for the Pskem, Oygaing and Tashkent stations, daily and monthly discharge for the Pskem gauge at Muallala, and the 2015 Pskem glacier catalogue.
groups.source: Uzhydromet workbooks delivered as spreadsheets, mapped onto stations already in the ontology
groups.note: The workbooks are printouts, not data: one block per variable, Roman month numerals, totals mixed in with observations. Every station already existed in the graph, so this maps rather than mints. A dash means zero in the precipitation blocks and missing everywhere else, which the build proves against the printed annual totals.

groups.title: Basin environmental attributes
groups.what: 281 documented hydro-environmental attributes per level-12 basin: hydrology, climate, land cover, soils, anthropogenic pressure.
groups.source: HydroATLAS / BasinATLAS v1.0 (Linke et al. 2019)

groups.title: National environmental atlas
groups.what: The 134-package thematic atlas: land and agriculture, biodiversity, climate, water, hazards, forests, infrastructure.
groups.source: Uzbekistan environmental atlas, ArcGIS layer packages
groups.rebuild: the source packages are in the private repository; derivatives build into WORKSPACE/
groups.note: Only the catalogue of the 134 packages is here. The packages and their web derivatives are not.

groups.title: Agricultural cadastre
groups.what: Parcel-level agricultural field geometry, region by region. Authoritative for tenure, not for physical land cover.
groups.source: UZKAD state cadastre feature service (db.ngis.uz), and an August 2025 extraction on the maps drop
groups.note: Never fetched on this machine. The download needs the UZKAD service and a local ogr2ogr; neither is available here.

groups.title: Monitoring station network
groups.what: Uzhydromet gauges and meteorological stations with coordinates and network membership.
groups.source: Uzhydromet delivery, 2022-05-26
groups.note: The 190 stations are in the graph with coordinates. The source shapefiles are on the maps drop.
missingPaths: maps-drop-2026-08 :: Kamchik pass temperature and precipitation

groups.title: Hazards and seismicity
groups.what: Earthquake epicentres 1990-2024, flood-risk polygons, glacial lakes and the derived seismicity clustering.
groups.source: Atlas derivatives and the seismicity analysis pipeline

groups.title: Protected areas
groups.what: Reserves and protected-area polygons.
groups.source: Atlas derivative

groups.title: Water management zones
groups.what: Irrigation and water-administration polygons.
groups.source: Atlas derivative

groups.title: Land use and land cover
groups.what: The land-use shape model derived from the atlas land-cover packages.
groups.source: Atlas derivative, PIPELINES/analysis
groups.note: The shape model is here; the polygonised rasters it describes are not.

groups.title: OpenStreetMap extract
groups.what: Buildings, roads and other OSM layers for Uzbekistan, 2014 vintage.
groups.source: Geofabrik / mapcruzin extract, on the maps drop
groups.rebuild: re-extract from Geofabrik, or re-attach the maps drop
groups.note: ODbL-1.0, so this is the one offline group with no licence obstacle to replacing.

groups.title: Agricultural and fertiliser statistics
groups.what: Crop statistics for all and irrigated land 2012-2020, and fertiliser series, as spreadsheets.
groups.source: Uzhydromet delivery, 2022-05-26; originating agency unconfirmed
missingPaths: maps-drop-2026-08 :: Crop statistics, all and irrigated land, 2012-2020
maps-drop-2026-08 :: Monthly mean evapotranspiration by region, 2020

groups.title: Household and service surveys
groups.what: Survey responses transferred by Uzhydromet.
groups.source: Uzhydromet transfer, 2022-05-27
groups.note: Flagged may-contain-personal-data and out-of-scope-for-the-portal. Handle before any use.

groups.title: The knowledge graph
groups.what: Typed assertions over datasets, distributions, layers, stations and agents, with the vocabularies and schemas that constrain them.
groups.source: Built by PIPELINES/ontology from the registries
groups.rebuild: npm run ontology:build  (needs WORKSPACE/ — see the README warning)

groups.title: Measured relationship tables
groups.what: Overlays that connect the layers to each other: basins to administrative units, atlas layers to basins, raster statistics per basin, and the river and lake routing.
groups.source: Built by the overlay pipelines
groups.note: The administrative and hydrographic tables are here. The atlas overlay and zonal statistics are not.
